runtime/unicode_character#

The native layer under logging/line, terminal/width, unicode/character: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under logging/line, terminal/width, unicode/character: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable Unicode 16.0.0 Character Database boundary for unicode/character. A backend may use vendored tables, platform libraries or VM intrinsics, but it must expose the same observable Unicode 16.0.0 data. Applications should use UnicodeCharacter instead of these raw actions.
